# QR Here

> The QR code scanner online lets you scan QR codes without any app. Upload an image or use your camera to scan a QR code. Also includes custom vector QR code generation completely in your browser.

## Core Tools

- [QR Code Scanner](https://qrhere.online/): Scan QR codes directly with your device webcam or by uploading image files. Decoded 100% locally in your browser with zero server uploads.
- [QR Code Generator](https://qrhere.online/qr-code-generator): Create customized vector QR codes with colors, dots, corners, and embedded logos with SVG or PNG export.

## Support & Documentation

- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://qrhere.online/faq): Answers to common questions regarding camera permissions, offline usage, and printing specifications.
- [About QR Here](https://qrhere.online/about): Background on our zero-knowledge architecture, performance design, and client-side processing.
- [Contact](https://qrhere.online/contact): Support, feedback, and technical inquiries for QR Here.

## Legal & Policies

- [Privacy Policy](https://qrhere.online/privacy): Clear disclosure explaining our client-side zero-knowledge architecture with no server storage.

## Articles & Guides

- [QR Code Blog](https://qrhere.online/blog): Practical tutorials, technical comparisons, and guides on QR codes.
- [How to Scan a QR Code Without an App](https://qrhere.online/blog/how-to-scan-qr-code-without-app): Step-by-step guide to scanning QR codes using your phone camera, web browser, or screenshots without installing third-party apps.
- [How to Create a vCard QR Code](https://qrhere.online/blog/how-to-create-vcard-qr-code): Guide on generating digital business card QR codes for smartphone address books.
- [Static vs Dynamic QR Code](https://qrhere.online/blog/static-vs-dynamic-qr-code): Comprehensive technical comparison between static and dynamic QR codes.
